mechanism: Prednisone increases gentamicin nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity by reducing renal function and impairing glomerular filtration, while gentamicin's aminoglycoside effects are potentiated by corticosteroid-induced immunosuppression.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and auditory function closely; maintain adequate hydration; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of gentamicin levels; use lowest effective prednisone dose; evaluate alternative antibiotics if possible.
